description: A festival operations director must approve the public-opening plan for a midnight film-and-performance event at a historic civic theater, including audience capacity, balcony access, electrical operating mode, accessibility routing, and a special-effects restriction.

shared_context.S1: The Midnight Reel event combines a feature-film screening, a live score, and a short theatrical effects sequence at the civic theater.
shared_context.S2: The draft venue plan lists 500 admitted guests, opens the balcony, runs the theater's standard HVAC setting, routes general entry through the west doors, and includes a brief open-flame effect.
shared_context.S3: Leah has authority to approve or reject the final public-opening plan.
shared_context.S4: The venue's standard approval routine is a pre-opening operations check in which the fire-safety, electrical, accessibility, and effects leads each report any conditions that must be written into the final plan before Leah signs it.

PF1.text: Mateo's fire-egress inspection found that the theater's current configuration permits exactly 420 guests and requires the balcony to remain closed because its north exit corridor is not clear; the signed inspection sheet arrived after the draft plan was circulated.

PF2.text: Sonia's load test found that projection, live-score amplification, and the theater's standard HVAC setting exceed the available feeder capacity together; the event can operate safely only with HVAC on reduced setting while projection and amplification remain on, and she completed the test after the draft was issued.

PF3.text: Nia confirmed during an access walkthrough that the west-door route has a step that cannot be covered before opening, while the east entrance has the inspected ramp route; the final plan must designate east-entry-with-ramp for mobility access, and the walkthrough notes have not yet been added to the venue packet.

PF4.text: Graham's current insurance endorsement excludes open flame at this venue but permits a cold-spark-free presentation using lighting and projected flame imagery instead; the insurer emailed the endorsement after the effects choice in the draft plan was made.

acceptance_conditions: The event must be approved only with the safe final operating plan.
The theater must use reduced HVAC while projection and live-score amplification operate.
Mobility access must use the east entrance with its inspected ramp route.
The open-flame sequence must be replaced by lighting and projected flame imagery.
A written commitment must document the capacity and balcony restriction.
A written commitment must document the reduced-HVAC power plan.
A written commitment must document the accessible east-entry route.
A written commitment must document the insurance-compliant effects change.

content_checks.C6: 'lighting' in decisions['effects_mode'] and ('projected flame imagery' in decisions['effects_mode'] or 'projected-flame-imagery' in decisions['effects_mode'] or 'projected flame' in decisions['effects_mode'] or 'projected-flame' in decisions['effects_mode']) and ('open flame' not in decisions['effects_mode'] or 'no open flame' in decisions['effects_mode'] or 'without open flame' in decisions['effects_mode'])
content_checks.C7: any('420' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('balcony' in c['detail'] and ('closed' in c['detail'] or 'remain closed' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('east' in c['detail'] and 'ramp' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any('lighting' in c['detail'] and 'projected' in c['detail'] and ('flame' in c['detail'] or 'imagery' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The inspection changes the audience number from the draft 500 to exactly 420, changes balcony access from open to closed, and requires the matching written restriction.
The load test changes the operating mode from standard HVAC to reduced HVAC with projection and amplification continuing, and requires that electrical condition to be cited and logged.
The access walkthrough changes the mobility route from the draft west doors to the east entrance with ramp and requires that route to be documented.
The insurance endorsement changes the effects from open flame to lighting and projected flame imagery and requires the compliant substitution to be recorded.
